title: NamespaceLabels
description: The labels of one namespace of a cluster, about namespace/<cluster>/<name>, which the hub copies from the cluster's spoke. A namespace whose labels this schema doesn't hold is refused whole, and never cut.

labels.description: The namespace's labels, sorted by key. At Kubernetes' longest key and value, 1000 labels take about 400 KB, which a record of the evidence store holds at its default cap even uncompressed.

key.description: A prefix of at most 253 characters and a slash, which Kubernetes allows, and a name of at most 63.
